text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото fears that she'll be
abandoned and
decides to leave on her
own accord. However, I
convince her to
stay, and we resume our training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her body's starting to show signs of
entering the
race-ready state. If it
continues, the Derby could
very well be
our next goal. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is completely put off by
the idea.
Her heart has yet to catch up
with her body. We
go back to gaining
gradual experience for the
time being.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
